author: marthomahew
name: reactking
short: Leaderboards for who gets the most of a reaction emoji.
description: `[p]reactking :kek:` shows who got the most :kek: reactions over a period, and `[p]awards` posts weekly reaction kings with optional winner roles. Self-reactions and bots don't count, and embedfix reposts count for the person who shared them.
install_msg: Loaded? Try `[p]reactking :kek:` (or any emoji). The bot needs Read Message History in the channels it should count.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
